parsed.post: Huge improvement! Using TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' with DEPTH=8 and MATRIX_LR=0.06 brought val_bpb down to 0.8858. The capacity increase and the extra data shard are compounding nicely. Next, I'll try reducing the batch size to increase the number of optimization steps within our 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Halving the total batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute training budget, while maintaining DEPTH=8 and TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'.
